//: ONE TABLE OF WORKED EXAMPLES, READ BY BOTH SIDES OF THE SEO SEAM.
A listing is described twice: by the API when it renders the listing document a crawler,
a scraper and a JavaScript-less reader see (src/Steeple.Api/Services/Seo/), and by the web
app when it moves between rooms in one session without asking for another document
(src/Steeple.Web.v2/src/ui/metaText.js). The two must say the same words about the same
room, or the same URL has two descriptions depending on how somebody arrived at it.
Neither implementation is the source of truth for the other. This file is, and it is
exercised from both suites, so a change to either side that drifts turns a test red:
Wire tokens as the words a person reads. The web app's registry is
src/Steeple.Web.v2/src/data/vocabulary.js; the API's is SeoText.Label. A token in
neither is humanized from its own spelling by both, identically.
